scope: Controlled PWA installation controller; no production installation claim

sources.applied: Feature may be absent or delayed. Retain a valid event at bootstrap; expose an explicit action only when an event is available.
Call prompt directly from user activation and at most once per event. Support the documented outcome and legacy userChoice fallback.
Browser appinstalled is separate evidence from the prompt choice.
Observe current standalone mode. Fullscreen alone is not used as installation evidence because ordinary pages can enter fullscreen.
Chromium appinstalled on Android can precede completion of WebAPK creation. UI must describe browser evidence without promising completed OS installation.

decisions: No user-agent inference or guaranteed browser installation instructions.
No automatic prompt, persistent installed flag, storage mutation, auth/license or worker change.
One lifetime controller is integrated by the distribution bootstrap, not recreated by locale or Help mounts.
